acquisition_method.evidence: Mass spectra were acquired in data-dependent mode with a high resolution (60,000) FTMS survey scan, mass range of m/z 375–1,575, followed by tandem mass spectra of the most intense precursors with a cycle time of 3 seconds.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Parameters included static modification of cysteine with carbamidomethyl and variable N-terminal acetylation.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Protein was trypsin (Sigma Aldrich) digested at 37°C for 18 hours, and the resulting peptides were desalted using C18 ZipTips (Millipore).
Fully tryptic peptides with a minimum of seven residues were required including cleavage between lysine and proline.

collision_energy.evidence: Fragmentation was performed with a precursor isolation window of 1.6 m/z, a maximum injection time of 50 ms, and HCD collision energy of 35%; the fragments were detected in the Orbitrap at a 15,000 resolution.
